subject_definitions:

{Jerry Seinfeld_BC} Wardrobe: wearing a dark navy jacket over a light blue button-up shirt, straight blue jeans, and white athletic sneakers. This exact wardrobe remains fixed throughout the sequence.

{George Costanza_BC} Wardrobe: wearing a brown zip-front jacket over a pale blue button-up shirt, dark charcoal trousers, and black leather shoes. This exact wardrobe remains fixed throughout the sequence.

<location:manhattan_game_world = A fictionalized early-1990s Manhattan open-world game map with blocky brick apartment buildings, simple storefronts, fire escapes, yellow taxis, traffic lights, crosswalks, low-detail pedestrians, boxy parked cars, and a distant simplified skyline.>

<object:yellow_sedan = A boxy early-1990s yellow four-door sedan built from a visibly simple low-polygon mesh, with flat windows, crude wheels, low-resolution textures, and basic damage states.>

<object:game_hud = A basic PC open-world-game HUD with a pixelated square minimap in the lower-left, chunky health bar, cash counter, mission objective, weapon icon, and wanted stars in the upper-right.>

detailed_description:

Actual low-resolution PC video-game gameplay from the fictional game "Seinfeld Theft Auto VI." HARD VISUAL CONSTRAINT: THIS MUST NEVER LOOK LIKE LIVE ACTION OR MODERN PHOTOREALISTIC GAME GRAPHICS. Target the graphical fidelity of a 2001-2004 PC/PlayStation 2-era 3D open-world game captured at roughly 480p and enlarged to fill the video frame. Characters must be visibly LOW-POLYGON GAME MODELS: angular heads, faceted cheeks, blocky hands, mitten-like fingers, polygonal noses, stiff hair meshes, painted low-resolution facial textures, blurry clothing textures, rigid joints, simple lip animation, and approximately 2,000-4,000 polygons per character. Preserve enough of the supplied likeness references to identify the characters, but translate those likenesses into crude early-2000s 3D game assets rather than reproducing high-resolution faces. Buildings, vehicles, streets, and pedestrians share the same limited graphical fidelity. Visible texture blur, jagged edges, texture stretching, short draw distance, simple circular shadows, baked lighting, low-resolution reflections, abrupt LOD changes, animation clipping, and 30-fps game motion are desirable. <object:game_hud> is permanently visible. No cinematic depth of field, film grain, realistic skin, individual hair strands, subsurface scattering, modern ray tracing, or photographic detail.

timeline:

[Shot 1] Third-person gameplay begins behind {Jerry Seinfeld_BC} sprinting down the sidewalk inside <location:manhattan_game_world>. His crude low-poly character model runs with a stiff looping animation while {George Costanza_BC} follows using another visibly canned running cycle. <object:game_hud> reads "STEAL A CAR." A blocky police cruiser jumps the curb behind them and knocks over a fire hydrant, which breaks into simple polygon pieces.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, {Jerry Seinfeld_BC} yanks open <object:yellow_sedan> using a fast canned carjacking animation. {George Costanza_BC} awkwardly runs around the vehicle while a police cruiser crashes into a taxi behind them. Simple orange explosion sprites and polygon debris erupt across the intersection.

[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, only {George Costanza_BC} fills a crude gameplay dialogue camera beside <object:yellow_sedan>. His face is obviously a low-resolution painted texture stretched across an angular head mesh. {George Costanza_BC} says, <d>[English §George Costanza_BC§]Jerry! They're shooting at us!</d>

[Shot 4] At 00:08.500, third-person vehicle gameplay follows <object:yellow_sedan> accelerating through the intersection. A police cruiser sideswipes it, sparks burst from simple particle emitters, the sedan spins around, clips two newspaper boxes, then regains control. <object:game_hud> jumps to three wanted stars and flashes "ESCAPE."

[Shot 5] At 00:12.000, <object:yellow_sedan> rockets downhill through traffic as two blocky police cruisers pursue. The sedan hits a crude wooden construction ramp and launches into the air. The rigid vehicle model hangs above the street while the chase camera swings mechanically behind it. Hold the airborne car through the final frames for the continuation.

overall_soundscape:

Deliberately compressed early-2000s game audio: looping engine samples, crude sirens, repetitive NPC shouts, simple gunshot effects, collision thumps, tire squeals, arcade explosions, HUD beeps, and heavily compressed dialogue.

non_diegetic_music:

Low-bitrate funky action-game soundtrack with slap bass, cheap sampled drums, distorted guitar stabs, and simple MIDI-like brass.
